title: Output of expired-jobs-checker
description: Results of expired-jobs-checker: the checks dataset (table view and all fields) and the run summary.

resultsDatasetUrl.title: Checks
resultsDatasetUrl.description: One row per input job URL/id: status open, closed or unknown, with when it was last seen (table columns only; allFieldsDatasetUrl has every field).

allFieldsDatasetUrl.title: Checks (all fields)
allFieldsDatasetUrl.description: Same rows with every field of the dataset schema, as JSON

runSummary.title: Run summary
runSummary.description: Run summary (key-value record RUN_SUMMARY): rows written, charged events, errors, failure class, duration and finish time
